biotools.summary: BIGSdb-Lm is a database and web-based tool that provides access to genomic data for *Listeria* isolates based on Multilocus Sequence Typing (MLST) and core genome MLST (cgMLST).  It facilitates data curation and phylogenetic analysis with a RESTful API available.
